F1_llama31_template_envelope.finding: the pinned Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct chat template emits an unrequested system block containing two date lines, on every render, under every condition.

empty_system_message_resolution_REJECTED.reason: empirically ineffective for this template, unlike Mistral (A1 E1) and OLMo-3.1-32B (A2 E8)
empty_system_message_resolution_REJECTED.template_evidence: the header and both date lines are emitted UNCONDITIONALLY, before system_message is interpolated: '{%- else %}{%- set system_message = "" %}{%- endif %} {{- "<|start_header_id|>system<|end_header_id|>\\n\\n" }} {{- "Cutting Knowledge Date: December 2023\\n" }} {{- "Today Date: " + date_string + "\\n\\n" }} {{- system_message }}'. There is no `if not has_system` guard of the kind that made the empty-system fix work for Mistral and OLMo.
empty_system_message_resolution_REJECTED.measured_consequence: an explicit empty system message renders BYTE-IDENTICALLY to user-only for all six conditions (6/6 identical), i.e. it is a verified no-op
empty_system_message_resolution_REJECTED.date_string_kwarg_also_insufficient: passing date_string changes only the second line; 'Cutting Knowledge Date: December 2023' persists
empty_system_message_resolution_REJECTED.conclusion: zero date residual is unattainable for this model with the official template unmodified. A3 therefore does NOT claim suppression.

resolution.decision: keep Llama-3.1 on the USER-ONLY envelope (no cosmetic empty system turn, since it provably changes nothing), and permit exactly one occurrence of the known literal block as expected tokenizer control structure
resolution.precedent: identical enumerate-and-permit pattern already approved for Mistral's empty [SYSTEM_PROMPT][/SYSTEM_PROMPT] pair (A1 E1), Qwen3's empty <think></think> pair, and Gemma's terminal <start_of_turn>model cue (A3 F3). In every case a specific, fully-enumerated, semantically empty control structure is permitted and everything else is still failed.
acceptance_criteria_all_required: the permitted literal appears exactly once, at position 0, byte-identical to the pinned sha256
after removing that single literal and the tokenizer's own special tokens, ZERO residual alphabetic words of 3+ characters remain
ZERO date hits and ZERO persona hits outside the permitted literal
the frozen user prompt appears VERBATIM in the render
the six frozen render hashes below reproduce exactly

why_the_old_requirement_is_withdrawn.measured_outcome: the real A100 preflight cache-on/cache-off check FAILED on 3 of 6 conditions
why_the_old_requirement_is_withdrawn.root_cause_assessment: cache-off is not a production path and follows a numerically different BF16 kernel path on this architecture (Olmo3: 48 sliding-window + 16 full-attention layers, YaRN rope scaling). Divergences begin at near-tie greedy argmax decisions between near-synonymous continuations and then compound autoregressively.
why_the_old_requirement_is_withdrawn.falsified_premise: C1_2's stated inference was that a cache mismatch 'would also threaten run-to-run reproducibility'. That inference is empirically false here: the cache-on path reproduced byte-identically across repeated calls in all six conditions while the cache-on/cache-off comparison failed in three.
why_the_old_requirement_is_withdrawn.cache_off_is_not_faster_or_slower_by_an_: measured 1.3x slower, not the ~10x O(n^2) inflation A2's use_cache_trap anticipated
explicitly_not_claimed: it is NOT claimed that the cache-on and cache-off computational paths are equivalent
it is NOT claimed that either path is 'the correct one'
the divergence is recorded as a PREFLIGHT ENGINEERING FINDING about kernel paths, never as a study result, and must not appear as one in the write-up

F3_gemma_terminal_generation_cue.finding: the Gemma-2-9B-it render tripped fail-condition 1 on the single residual word 'model', which originates solely from the template's terminal generation cue '<start_of_turn>model'. Gemma names its assistant role 'model' rather than 'assistant'.
F3_gemma_terminal_generation_cue.assessment:
a gate false positive, not a content leak. The render is '<bos><start_of_turn>user
<frozen prompt><end_of_turn>
<start_of_turn>model
' -- no system block, no date, no persona, no tool text.

resolution.decision: treat ONLY the exact terminal generation cue as expected tokenizer control structure
rules_all_required: the cue is recognised ONLY as the terminal element of the render (trailing whitespace permitted after it)
the cue must appear EXACTLY ONCE in the whole render
arbitrary occurrences of the bare word 'model' are NOT whitelisted anywhere
the word 'model' appearing anywhere other than inside that single terminal cue is a residual-content FAILURE
the frozen user prompt must appear VERBATIM
ZERO other residual semantic content, ZERO date hits, ZERO persona hits
resolution.explicitly_rejected_alternative: adding 'model' to the global control-token list. That would blind the gate to a mid-prompt injection containing the word, and would apply to scorers for which it is not a role name.
